gloss: route; course; path; line of reasoning

definitions.explanation: A physical path or route from one place to another.

definitions.gloss: course of action; roadmap; line of reasoning
definitions.explanation: Figuratively, the logical steps or process leading toward a goal or conclusion. Common in discussions of plans, policies, and arguments.

examples.japanese: {目的地|もくてきち}までの{道筋|みちすじ}を{確認|かくにん}した。
examples.english: I confirmed the route to the destination.

examples.japanese: パレードの{道筋|みちすじ}に{人|ひと}が{集|あつ}まっていた。
examples.english: People had gathered along the parade route.

examples.japanese: {祭|まつ}りの{行列|ぎょうれつ}が{通|とお}る{道筋|みちすじ}には{提灯|ちょうちん}が{飾|かざ}られていた。
examples.english: Lanterns were hung along the route of the festival procession.

examples.japanese: {解決|かいけつ}への{道筋|みちすじ}を{示|しめ}す。
examples.english: To show a path toward resolution.

examples.japanese: {話|はなし}の{道筋|みちすじ}がよくわからない。
examples.english: I can't follow the line of the story.

examples.japanese: {政府|せいふ}は{経済|けいざい}{回復|かいふく}に{向|む}けた{具体的|ぐたいてき}な{道筋|みちすじ}をまだ{示|しめ}していない。
examples.english: The government has yet to present a concrete roadmap toward economic recovery.

notes:
USAGE NOTES:
The figurative use of {道筋|みちすじ} (course of action, reasoning) is more common than the literal use in modern Japanese. It often appears in news and political discussions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {道筋|みちすじ}を{示|しめ}す (to show a path/roadmap)
- {道筋|みちすじ}を{立|た}てる (to map out a course)
- {道筋|みちすじ}が{見|み}える (a path becomes visible)
- {話|はなし}の{道筋|みちすじ} (thread/line of a story)
- {解決|かいけつ}への{道筋|みちすじ} (path to resolution)
